title: Poisonous Concoction Pathfinder
overview:
Level on a temporary bow, then use Poisonous Concoction with life flasks. The Bouncing gem takes over in maps.

Build reference by Hayura. Original guide: https://pobarchives.com/build/hD3xLPYF
Original PoB: https://pobb.in/ZJeQD3GN5N9N

Campaign items illustrate equipment progression. Use linked campaign drops you can equip. Some utility groups in campaign sets become available in later acts. Check gem requirements and combat assumptions before purchasing gear. Set the character level when you switch loadouts.

stages.title: Act 1 · Temporary bow
stages.goal: Use Caustic Arrow and Shrapnel Ballista until level 12.

stages.title: Acts 2–5 · Poisonous Concoction
stages.priority: Upgrade life flasks and chance to poison.

stages.title: Acts 6–10 · Finish the campaign
stages.goal: Keep regular Poisonous Concoction until you can obtain Bouncing.

stages.title: Atlas · Bouncing on rare gear
stages.goal: Swap to Poisonous Concoction of Bouncing.
stages.priority: Buy or obtain the transfigured gem and keep a reliable flask setup.

stages.title: Maps · Full starter investment
stages.goal: Follow the later mapping setup after checking poison chance and flask sustain.
stages.priority: Compare the cost of more investment with your next build.
